title: Liz Zips the Bag
lines: Liz has a red bag and it zips up.
A bun, a fig and jam are in it.
A big bug zips at the bag. Zap!
Liz zips the bag up. "Not yet, bug!"
The bug sits on a log and is mad.
"You can have a bit," said Liz.
Liz sets a bit of bun on the log.
The bug has the bit and is not mad.

questions.ask: What did Liz have in the bag?
questions.listenFor: A bun, a fig and jam. If your child only names one, that is fine - ask "what else?" and let them look back.

questions.ask: Why did Liz zip the bag up?
questions.listenFor: To keep the bug out of her food. The story does not say it in those words, so working it out together is the point.

questions.ask: Do you think Liz did the right thing at the end? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. Listen for a reason - she shared, or the bug stopped being cross. A reason from the story beats a yes or no.
